name: diffusion_only_2d
description: Uniform 38 mmHg field with Dirichlet boundary, no cells. Tests LOD Thomas solver alone.
_note: Needs a generic PhysiCell binary (the 'template' sample project, built from PhysiCell/sample_projects/template). The bundled 'heterogeneity' binary has cancer-cell logic baked in and crashes on configs without it. If template binary is missing this scenario is SKIPPED rather than failed.
